title: Community Boating, Inc.
specs: Sailboats include Sonar-23 keelboats that cannot capsize
Kayak rental age minimum 9 years old; under 10 must be in double kayak with parent or guardian
Ages 10-15 must be 40 inches tall and accompanied on water by parent or guardian
Ages 16-17 may kayak alone with signed permission from parent or guardian
Life jackets must be worn at all times on any vessel
Corporate group outings available for 20 or more people with kayak reservations at $34 per person for 2 hours

services.name: Sailing Boat Rental for Corporate Functions

blurb: Guests can rent kayaks and stand-up paddleboards to explore the Charles River Basin and nearby lagoons. Sailing outings and corporate events are available with instruction and use of keelboats. Memberships provide access to boats, classes, and discounted events.
tags: Sailing Boat Rental for Corporate Functions
extraNote: All memberships are non-refundable and non-transferable · Operations may be suspended during adverse weather including lightning, fog, extreme heat, and high winds · Corporate outings not cancelled for rain but may be cancelled for safety concerns like strong winds or lightning · Dock house at Community Boating, 21 David G Mugar Way, Boston, MA · April 1 to October 31
